extension.summary: SHK-005 dev.2-r1 - English catalogue sync and visual corrections
extension.description: Development candidate: corrected Home layout, direct bundled artwork loading, native font names, subtler glass focus and TV Guide cells. Movies and TV Series request explicitly labelled EN / ENG / English / UK provider categories only, with no full-catalogue fallback. Requires provider category support; labels do not guarantee audio language. Optional automatic opening and Android-reference eclipse animation. Connection changes remain passcode protected. Preserves the .57 playback/account adapter. No channels or subscriptions supplied. Native Kodi/Xbox acceptance remains required.
